question: What is the difference in total gas consumption between EUR-paying and CZK-paying customers in the year with the highest overall consumption among CZK-paying customers?

    WHERE T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4)

WITH target_year AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) AS year_str
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4)
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
WHERE SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = (SELECT year_str FROM target_year)

WITH czk_years AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) AS year,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_czk_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011)
),
max_czk_year AS (
    SELECT year
    FROM czk_years
    ORDER BY total_czk_consumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
eur_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_eur_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = (SELECT year FROM max_czk_year)
),
czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_czk_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = (SELECT year FROM max_czk_year)
)
SELECT 
    ABS(e.total_eur_consumption - c.total_czk_consumption) AS difference
FROM eur_consumption e
CROSS JOIN czk_consumption c
